label: Telegram Bridge
info:
Bridges Telegram to HA via Node-RED.
Voice → Gemini STT → telegram_text event.
Text → telegram_text event.

SETUP:
1. Double-click 'Mia Bot' config and enter bot token
2. Edit 'Set Tokens' function: enter API keys
3. In 'Fire HA Event' node: select your HA server
4. Deploy

name: Set Tokens
